user.title: Halo Sync

data.tv_host: TV IP address (optional, overrides the selection)
data.hue_host: Hue bridge IP address (optional, overrides the selection)
data.adb_source: TV source sensor via ADB (the TV asks once to allow debugging)
data.rescan: Scan the network again (tick it and submit)

tv_pin.title: TV pairing
tv_pin.description: Enter the PIN shown on the TV.

hue_link.title: Hue bridge
hue_link.description: Press the link button on the Hue bridge, then submit within 30 seconds.

area.title: Entertainment area
area.description: Choose the Hue entertainment area the TV colors are sent to.

reconfigure.title: Change addresses
reconfigure.description: Change the address of the TV or the Hue bridge, for example after the router gave them a new IP. The pairing and your presets are kept. Next you can choose the entertainment area.

reconfigure_area.title: Entertainment area
reconfigure_area.description: Choose the Hue entertainment area the TV colors are sent to.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again
reauth_confirm.description: The TV or the Hue bridge no longer accepts the stored pairing. Choose what to pair again.

reauth_tv.title: Pair the TV again
reauth_tv.description: The TV no longer accepts the stored pairing, for example after a reset. Switch the TV on and submit. A PIN then appears on the TV.

reauth_tv_pin.title: TV pairing
reauth_tv_pin.description: Enter the PIN shown on the TV.

reauth_hue_link.title: Link the Hue bridge again
reauth_hue_link.description: The Hue bridge no longer accepts the stored key. Press the link button on the bridge, then submit within 30 seconds.

error.tv_unreachable: Could not reach the TV or start pairing.
error.bad_pin: Wrong or expired PIN. A new PIN is now shown on the TV.
error.hue_unreachable: Could not reach the Hue bridge.
error.link_button: Link button not pressed. Press it and submit again.
error.no_tv: Choose a TV from the list or type its IP address.
error.no_bridge: Choose a Hue bridge from the list or type its IP address.
error.no_areas: The bridge has no entertainment areas. Create one in the Hue app, then submit again.
error.tv_auth: The TV no longer accepts the stored pairing. Pair it again with the re-authentication notice for Halo Sync under Settings > Devices & services.

abort.already_configured: This TV and entertainment area are already configured.

data_description.adb_source: Shows the current TV input as a sensor. The TV asks once to allow debugging.
data_description.tv_endpoint: Where the TV colors are read. Measured works on most TVs. Processed answers faster, but is all zeros on some newer firmware.

lights_off_with_tv.name: Lights off when TV turns off

activate_preset.name: Activate preset
activate_preset.description: Switch the Halo Sync preset (by name or id).
